name: exact-counterexample
label: Exact counterexample witness
description: Use against a UNIVERSAL claim: provide one exact assignment where the claim's predicate fails. The verifier recomputes everything itself (exact integer arithmetic). Exit 0 = witness confirmed → target claim FALSIFIED. Exit 1 = predicate actually holds at the assignment (witness refuted, inconclusive).

inputs.name: expression
inputs.description: integer arithmetic over the assignment variables (functions: abs,min,max,gcd,isqrt,collatz_steps,collatz_max)

inputs.name: predicate
inputs.description: what FAILS at the witness, e.g. not_prime | not_divisible_by:K | collatz_steps_greater_than:K
